definitions.gloss: new bud, new sprout, young shoot
definitions.explanation: A newly emerging bud or shoot on a plant. Associated with spring and the start of new growth.

examples.japanese: {木|き}に{新芽|しんめ}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: New buds have started to appear on the tree.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると{新芽|しんめ}が{一斉|いっせい}に{芽吹|めぶ}く。
examples.english: When spring comes, new buds sprout all at once.

examples.japanese: {お茶|おちゃ}の{新芽|しんめ}を{摘|つ}んで{新茶|しんちゃ}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: New tea leaves are picked to make shincha (first-harvest tea).

notes:
USAGE:
Associated with spring and renewal. In the tea world, {新芽|しんめ} refers to the first tender leaves of the season, which are prized for producing {新茶|しんちゃ} (first-flush tea).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新芽|しんめ}が{出|で}る: new buds emerge
- {新芽|しんめ}が{芽吹|めぶ}く: new buds sprout
- {新芽|しんめ}を{摘|つ}む: to pick new buds
- {新芽|しんめ}が{伸|の}びる: new shoots grow
